limitations: Repair may join overlaps/fill gaps/round details; alpha and offset are not certified maximum deviations.

Thickness sizing is a global cap, not locally adaptive. Fidelity uses sampling, not a Hausdorff certificate.
No gargoyle solve or fresh complete release resource calibration is claimed.
